m: स्वश m. pl. N. of a people (prob. w.r. for खश), Buddh.
स्व—शक्ति f. own power or strength, Mn. ix, 298
स्व—शक्त्या (या), ind. to the best of one's ability, Pañcat.; Siṃhās.
स्व—शरीर n. o˚'s own body or person, R.
स्वश्—चूडामणि m. the crest-jewel of heaven, BhP.
स्व्-अश्व mf(आ)n. having excellent horses, well mounted, well yoked, RV.
स्व्-अश्वयु mfn. fond of good steeds (others, ‘wishing to be a good courser’), RV.
स्व्-अश्व्य n. possession of good horses, RV.
